prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en invandrare". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "immigrant".
Scene: A woman arriving with moving suitcases at a new home in Sweden, a small Swedish flag near the doorway and a welcoming neighbour.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "invandrare = immigrant; picture arriving to live in a new country.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon kom till Sverige som invandrare.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established Swedish vocabulary card layout, described in the prompt; no image supplied to generation.
